sections.heading: Overview
bullets: No invulnerable split — just an escalating mix of orb management, a scripted "phase or glide" ultimatum, and two hard-stack mechanics late in the fight. 7-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Spectral Darkness (orbs)
bullets: Starting at 66% HP, dark orbs spawn and expand — contact stacks <mark>Spectral Darkness</mark>, which reduces your outgoing damage and increases your incoming damage by 10% per stack.
Destroying an orb drops a golden energy pickup that clears 5 stacks — grab it.
Ranged players are responsible for popping any orb that spawns close to Gorseval — don't leave those for melee to deal with.

sections.heading: World Eater
bullets: If Gorseval isn't phased in time, <mark>World Eater</mark> fills the arena and kills anyone still in it.
Counter it by DPSing him to the next health barrier (66%, 33%, or 0%) before it goes off, or by breaking through the arena walls and gliding to an updraft to wait it out.
4 updrafts ring the platform, but each is single-use per cycle — if the squad needs to glide more than once, move to a different updraft each time.

sections.heading: Ghastly Rampage (CC phase)
bullets: Gorseval gets a defiance bar and starts reflecting damage during <mark>Ghastly Rampage</mark> — use CC skills to break the bar, and avoid multi-hit skills that punish you on the reflect.
Black goop spawns around the arena and detonates for 50% of your health plus 25 stacks of vulnerability — don't stand in it.
Aim for a "Fast, Fast, Slow" DPS rhythm through this phase rather than dumping everything at once.

sections.heading: Charged Souls (66% / 33%)
bullets: 4 Charged Souls spawn and slowly walk toward Gorseval — either zerg all 4 down together, or split into north/south pairs if the squad prefers.

This one has real teeth: if a Charged Soul reaches Gorseval, he immediately casts World Eater regardless of his health. The cast has a long enough windup that the squad can still save it — push DPS to force the next phase break before it finishes, or run/glide clear like a normal World Eater — but it's not a mistake you get to just shrug off either.

sections.heading: Swipes, slams & eggs
bullets: Position behind Gorseval to avoid his frontal <mark>Wicked Swipe</mark>; dodge or use protection for <mark>Spectral Impact</mark>, his ground-slam, which knocks back.
At 33% HP, <mark>Ghastly Prison</mark> encases every player in an egg — stack tight right before they appear, then sidestep out once they land. If you get trapped, break free with weapon skill 1.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 7:00 — at enrage the updrafts disappear and Gorseval deals +200% damage.
